name: MQTT
summary: Subscribe to MQTT 3.1.1 topics on a broker and log each message as a durable stream record, acknowledged only after it is committed to disk.

fields.name: password
fields.label: Password
fields.help: Read from a file that only its owner can access, named in ingest.json or by a secret_ref.

fields.name: client_key_file
fields.label: Client private key (PEM)
fields.help: A file that only its owner can access.

settings.name: broker_port
settings.label: Broker port
settings.help: Defaults to 8883 with TLS and 1883 without.

settings.name: ca_file
settings.label: CA certificates (PEM)
settings.help: Trust roots to use instead of the platform's.

settings.name: topics
settings.label: Topic filters
settings.help: Comma-separated filters; the workflow node holds them as a list.

settings.name: client_id
settings.label: Client ID
settings.help: Stable, so the broker keeps the persistent session. Default: ogun- and 12 hex digits of BLAKE3.

egress.note: The broker you set, on the port you set.

operators.summary: Subscribe to MQTT topics and log each message as a stream record that feeds window partitions.

implementation.evidence: unit and loopback tests; not run against a real broker, network server or device

notes: Runs in the ogun-ingest bridge, not in ogund. The session is persistent and the PUBACK follows the commit, so a broker queues messages while the bridge restarts; copies are removed by the stream's dedupe_key. MQTT 5 is not wired yet. A broker URL with credentials in it is refused (O-10 section 2.4.1).
